description: Recuperated sCO2 Brayton cycle: eta = eta_rated * (1 - a*(1-PLR)^2), Carnot capped.

cycle.name: Recompression sCO2 Brayton (Allam-style not modelled here)
cycle.source: Dostal, Driscoll & Hejzlar (2004) MIT-ANP-TR-100; Crespi et al. (2017) Appl. Energy 195, 152-183; Wright et al. (2010) SAND2010-0171.

P_rated.note: Rated electrical output (10 MWe demonstrator class)

eta_rated.note: Rated cycle thermal efficiency at design point (~0.45-0.50 typical)

a_partload.note: Part-load loss coefficient (sCO2 is relatively flat)
